title: calluna vulgaris f. plena
intro: Calluna vulgaris f. plena, commonly known as the double-flowered heather, is a flowering plant that belongs to the heather family, Ericaceae. This plant is known for its ornamental value and has been traditionally used in herbal medicine due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Calluna vulgaris f. plena include wound healing, skin protection, and the treatment of respiratory issues such as bronchitis and coughs. The bioactive constituents of this plant include phenolic compounds, flavonoids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
